title: introduce cvg dash — TUI dashboard crate (ADR-0029)
task_body: Carve out a convergio-tui crate that hosts the htop-style 4-pane dashboard (plans / agents / tasks / PRs). Wire cvg dash through the CLI to launch it. Initial palette + render loop + crate skeleton plus the new ADR.
rationale: New crate + workspace member entry in root Cargo.toml; lib.rs is the entry; dash.rs is the CLI shell; ADR records the carve-out.
